overview: Fenn Rau is a mandalorian protector hunter from Concord Dawn, documented across Clone Wars · Rebels. Mandalorian Protector who enforced Concord Dawn neutrality through hunter-precision strikes against pirates and Separatist incursions.
history:
Fenn Rau rose from Concord Dawn to become a mandalorian protector hunter whose name appears on guild boards from the Core to the Outer Rim. Fenn Rau commanded Mandalorian Protectors on Concord Dawn, posting hunter-style interceptions against anyone violating system neutrality during the Clone Wars. Bounty puck archives, Imperial warrant logs, and Hutt contract registries all document Fenn Rau as a contractor who shaped wars without wearing a uniform. Coverage spans all nine saga films, Clone Wars, Rebels, Mandalorian, Book of Boba Fett, Andor, KOTOR, KOTOR II, SWTOR, and Sith Empire-era mercenary markets.

Even before Fenn Rau's career, Concord Dawn produced hunters, soldiers, and syndicate enforcers whose traditions fed the modern guild system. Concord Dawn supplied mercenary hunters to Old Republic charter markets and Sith Empire shadow rolls long before Fenn Rau posted the contracts that made them infamous. Old Republic bounty charters and Sith Empire mercenary rolls show how mandalorian protector hunter contractors were hired to bypass political treaties. Mandalorian foundling laws and Hutt kajidic codes both influenced how hunters like Fenn Rau negotiate payment and honor.

In the modern era, Fenn Rau competed on postings issued by the Empire, the Rebellion, the Hutt Cartel, and independent monarchs alike. Fenn Rau remained active through Imperial guild consolidation, Rebellion-era shadow postings, and New Republic amnesty debates—pucks archived on Nar Shaddaa, Ord Mantell, and Nevarro alike. Post-Endor guild restructuring and New Republic amnesty debates still reference contracts linked to Fenn Rau. Mandalorian-era postings on Nevarro and Mos Espa show mandalorian protector hunter specialists remain essential to galactic order—and chaos.

Fenn Rau operated in war zones where capture alive paid more than kill, and both paid more than failure. Rau later cooperated with Rebels after Imperial compromise, applying Protector hunter doctrine to Phoenix Squadron escort operations. KOTOR-era Nar Shaddaa boards and TOR-era Great Galactic War contracts show earlier generations of mandalorian protector hunter hunters in the same blood-stained market. Jedi, Sith, and clone troopers alike learned to respect or fear Fenn Rau's approach to pursuit and extraction.
